description: This file contains automated tests for browser file upload and download functionalities using Playwright. It includes tests for file upload via file chooser, download link handling, and access restrictions based on configured roots and flags.

methods.name: browser_file_upload
methods.description: Test case for uploading files through browser file input, handling modal states, and error conditions.

methods.name: clicking on download link emits download
methods.description: Test case for clicking a download link on the page and verifying download event.

methods.name: navigating to download link emits download
methods.description: Test for navigating directly to a download URL and verifying the file is downloaded.

methods.name: file upload restricted to roots by default
methods.description: Test for restricting file uploads to within specified root directories.

methods.name: file upload is restricted to cwd if no roots are configured
methods.description: Test for default restriction to current working directory when no roots are configured.

methods.name: file upload unrestricted when flag is set
methods.description: Test for allowing unrestricted file uploads when a specific configuration flag is enabled.
